snippet.title: Skyfear - Teaser Trailer (2019)
snippet.description:
Skyfear is available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/814330/Skyfear/

Protoria Studios releases official teaser trailer for Skyfear, an upcoming dragon arena shooter. This is from Spring 2019. If you'd like to see where the game's at NOW, visit us on Discord: https://discord.gg/Jq8tVKn

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/814330/Skyfear/
